title: One repo that connects to all my other repos
description: Hub and spoke on the dark grid: one repo holding an index of topics, a repo map and the workflows, wired to six GitHub repos, and under it the loop that keeps it current (agent session, the review when it ends, facts added and rules proposed back to the hub, marked by a "knowledge updated" pill). Replicated from the team's own diagram.
source: The team's own diagram "One repo that connects to all my other repos" (Nov 2026), replicated; all text is from it.
